newsitem.title: UK: AEA Technology rises to first day premium.
newsitem.headline: AEA Technology rises to first day premium.

text.p: Shares in AEA Technology Plc rose to a sharp premium on its first day's trading on Thursday after a heavily-oversubscribed privatisation issue.

After touching a high of 332p in early trading the stock was at 322p by 0842 GMT, well ahead of the 280p flotation price, in heavy trading of 11.9 million shares -- making it the most active stock in the UK market.

AEA, the science and engineering services arm of the Atomic Energy Authority, was valued at 224 million stg at the issue price. The price was increased during the flotation from a first range between 240p and 270p after stronger-than-expected demand.

Mike Watson, AEA's executive director for marketing and sales, said the company was happy with the response from investors to the offer and with the stock's performance, though the company wanted to see a stable investor base established.
"We have been quietly pleased at the market's initial response which reflects the hard work which has gone in," Watson told Reuters.
